summary: Confirmed DONE (landed in #710, 60633eff3). The finding's measured waterfall was on the cold drawer path: the PTY spawn waited for the chunk, the Suspense reveal and xterm fit, and each mount sent 2 resizes. That waterfall is gone. ChatTerminalShell calls prepareThreadTerminal as soon as the drawer is open and visible while the xterm chunk is still loading. The drawer's openTerminal then takes that in-flight promise instead of opening again. Prepare and drawer share one cwd/env resolver (terminalLaunchKey checks they match), and hosted capability is checked first. The drawer now mounts through useLazyComponentReady, so the Suspense throttle no longer applies. Resizes are 0 or 1 per mount: the 30 ms timer and the rAF effect are both skipped until hydration and only fire when the fitted size changed. When the chunk is already loaded (hover or idle preload, later opens), no prepare runs, but the mount happens in the same commit and the open is sent from a layout effect right after xterm construction, so only a few tens of ms stay serialized. The hover/pointerenter PTY prewarm was not implemented, on purpose: a fresh start still force-opens the drawer (store.ts:813-831). I found no functional bugs or regressions. The residuals below are small.

evidence.note: prepareThreadTerminal: one in-flight terminal.open per (env, thread, terminal), deduped by launchKey, 10 s TTL (:134). Uses the last fitted size per layout (:99). Skips when hosted terminalOpen capability is not granted (:171). No xterm imports.

resolveThreadTerminalLaunch is the shared cwd/worktree/env resolver used by the chat drawer, the workspace terminal tab and prepare. This addresses the verifier's concern that a cwd/env mismatch makes the server relaunch the PTY and wipe its history (Manager.ts:2236-2241 relaunch rule).

Prepare effect fires when visible && drawerOpen && launch && the chunk is not loaded, so it runs on toggle, shortcut, server start and persisted-open reload. `visible` includes terminalCapability.allowed (ChatView.tsx:6359-6364), so on hosted the effect re-runs once access is granted. useLazyComponentReady (:85) replaces the old React.lazy + Suspense (f1be4abc7 ChatTerminalShell.tsx:14,155).

The terminal tab prepares with the same resolver, but this code lives inside the lazy ThreadWorkspacePanel chunk and WorkspaceTerminalPanel only renders when the terminal tab is active (:1506-1507). With a cold panel shell, the spawn still waits for the shell chunk. That chunk is preloaded on hover/idle (ChatRightPanel.tsx:141-145).

openTerminal takes takePreparedTerminalOpen and awaits prepared.promise instead of calling api.terminal.open. lastSentDimensionsRef is seeded with the prepared size (:1004-1008). Snippet and resync opens bypass it.

After hydration there is at most one resize (sendResizeIfChanged :973). The fitTimer resize is skipped until hydrated (:1127). The rAF effect skips before hydration or when the size is unchanged (:1286-1291). The open runs from a layout effect (usePaneEffect, PaneFocus.tsx:46), so on a loaded chunk it starts right after xterm construction.

The test checks that a prepared open is taken (open called once) and that there is no resize when the sizes match. Despite its title ('resizes once if the fit differs'), it never exercises the size-differs branch. No test covers the prepare wiring in ChatTerminalShell or WorkspaceTerminalPanel (prepare fires before the chunk resolves and the total open count stays at 1).

A non-replay, non-quiet started event still forces terminalOpen=true and switches the active terminal. That is why hover prewarm is unsafe (terminalPrepare.ts:14-21). A quiet-start mechanism now exists, but only by terminal-id prefix for setup scripts (:815-816, added in #728).

Hover/focus on the terminal toggle only preloads the drawer chunk. When that chunk is already loaded at click time, prepare is skipped by design (it would race the same-commit mount and leave an unconsumed entry), and the mount opens at once.

fixDefects: No functional bugs or regressions found. Minor non-blocking items: (1) Coverage: the browser test at ThreadTerminalDrawer.browser.tsx:598 is named for the 'fit differs -> exactly one resize' case but only asserts the equal-size branch. ChatTerminalShell.tsx:91 and ThreadWorkspacePanel.tsx:504 have no wiring tests. (2) Some prepared entries are never consumed: a snippet-insertion mount skips takePreparedTerminalOpen (ThreadTerminalDrawer.tsx:995), and a prepare can target a terminal whose viewport never mounts. Such entries stay up to 10 s, and a later mount adopts their older snapshot plus the buffered events. That is intended per the TTL comment, but it depends on event-buffer retention. (3) The window in which a fresh PTY's started event re-opens a drawer the user just closed now starts at the click, not after chunk load and reveal. It is only about spawn time plus one round trip, and only for a new PTY, which is the same order as before. (4) rememberTerminalDimensions is shared by all viewports of a layout (split panes, hidden drawers), so the stored size can be off and cost one resize later.
implementationSketch: Optional follow-ups, none required to close the finding. (a) Tests: in ThreadTerminalDrawer.browser.tsx, add a case where the fitAddon mock returns a different size than the prepared 80x24 and assert terminal.resize is called exactly once with the fitted size. Add a ChatTerminalShell browser test: keep LazyThreadTerminalDrawer pending, set terminalOpen=true, assert terminal.open is called once before the chunk resolves, then resolve the chunk and assert the open count is still 1. Add the same test for WorkspaceTerminalPanel with layout 'panel'. (b) Cold workspace-panel path: move the panel prepare out of the lazy shell. In ChatView, when the right-panel mode becomes 'terminal' (route change, the workspace.terminal shortcut in useChatGlobalShortcuts.ts:139-144, launcher click), call prepareThreadTerminal with resolveThreadTerminalLaunch({projectCwd, threadWorktreePath, launchContext: store launch context}) and layout 'panel', guarded by !loadThreadTerminalDrawer.isLoaded() and paneFocused. Keep the in-panel effect as a fallback; launchKey dedupe makes the second call a no-op. (c) Hover prewarm, only if product wants it: add an exact-key 'prepared start' registry to the terminal store (a sibling of quietTerminalStartPrefixByThreadKey, keyed by thread+terminalId, cleared on take or TTL). The started handler would treat those starts as quiet unless the drawer is already open. Then call prepareThreadTerminal from the BranchToolbar onPointerEnter/onFocus. Test with a store unit test (a prepared start does not set terminalOpen) and a browser test (hover, no drawer open; click, open count 1).
decisionReason: The finding is closed. Only the optional hover/pointerenter PTY prewarm would need a product decision: it spawns shells and runs the user's .zshrc on hover without an explicit open, and it needs a store change so a prepared start does not force the drawer open.
correction: No change to the auditor's status. Additions: the browser test only covers the equal-size branch (not 'resizes once if the fit differs' as its title says), and the ChatTerminalShell/WorkspaceTerminalPanel prepare wiring has no tests. When the chunk is already loaded (hover or idle preload), no prepare runs; this is fine because the mount and open happen in the same commit through a layout effect.
